words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.ex: Thousands of people attended the concert.
words.ex_cn: 数千人参加了这场音乐会。
words.en: A large number of something, typically more than a thousand.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr: phrase. 越来越少；越来越少地；逐渐减少地
words.ex: He has less and less time to play video games.
words.ex_cn: 他玩电子游戏的时间越来越少。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is decreasing in quantity or degree over time.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: The rainstorm came suddenly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚暴雨突然来了。
words.en: A rainstorm is a storm with heavy rain.

words.ex: The snowstorm stopped all traffic yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天暴风雪让所有交通都停了。
words.en: A snowstorm is a very heavy fall of snow, usually with strong winds.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: We stayed indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
words.en: If you are indoors, you are inside a building.

words.ex: The cat sat in the doorway.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在门口。
words.en: A doorway is the space in a wall where a door opens and closes, or the covered area just outside a door.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: The aftershock shook the house again.
words.ex_cn: 余震再次震动了房子。
words.en: An aftershock is a smaller earthquake that occurs after a previous large earthquake, in the same area of the main shock.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: The nation celebrated its independence day.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家庆祝了它的独立日。
words.en: A nation is a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture, and history, who live in a particular area under one government.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.tr: adj. 受伤的；受损害的； v. “injure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 受伤的球员被送往医院。
words.en: If you are injured, you have been hurt, usually in an accident or attack.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: The headmaster welcomed the new students.
words.ex_cn: 校长欢迎新生。
words.en: A headmaster is the man who is the head teacher of a school.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.tr: adv. 妥善保管地；安全地；稳妥地；安全地；
words.ex: She safely stored her jewelry in a safe.
words.ex_cn: 她妥善保管地把珠宝存放在保险箱里。
words.en: In a way that is not likely to cause harm or damage; securely.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: He lives in an english-speaking country.
words.ex_cn: 他住在英语国家。
words.en: Using or able to use English as a means of communication.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: The redwood trees are very tall.
words.ex_cn: 红杉树非常高。
words.en: A redwood is a very tall tree that grows in California, known for its height and longevity.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr: phrase. 沉浸于；沉迷于；专注于（某事）
words.ex: He loses himself in music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都沉浸在音乐中。
words.en: To become so involved in something that you do not notice anything else.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.
